title: Rockford Art Museum

services.name: Rental Inquiry
services.desc: Rockford Art Museum provides a memorable and unique event space. Located inside the Riverfront Museum Park building at 711 North Main Street in downtown Rockford, Illinois, the museum galleries have open floor plans, high ceilings and terrazzo floor, offering unlimited possibilities. RAM offers use of a large catering kitchen, up to 40 round tables, 12 high top tables, and help with space planning.
